scope: Additive Dragon Duke TH18 L21-L25 numeric evidence audit. This delta intentionally does not enable a Core actor because the consulted public sources do not yield one unambiguous current base combat contract.
game_version: Current numeric values are a secondary game-file transcription reporting client build 18.400.21. Official 2026 balance notes establish later changes to trap reduction but do not state the resulting value.

sources.title: Dragon Duke | Clash of Clans Wiki | Goblins Farm
sources.version: client build 18.400.21, as reported by publisher
sources.limitations: Reports current health and DPS only. It does not publish an attack range, cadence, projectile contract or passive values.

sources.title: July Balance Update
sources.limitations: Confirms a further reduction to Dragon Duke trap damage reduction and that his rage was otherwise untouched. It does not publish the resulting trap reduction or an exact base combat table.

sources.title: The February 2026 update is here!
sources.limitations: Claims flying melee base attack at 1.25 tiles, speed 20, cadence 1.2 seconds, a six-tile isolation predicate, x2 damage and x1.5 attack speed. It predates later balance updates.

sources.title: Dragon Duke
sources.limitations: Current-looking community table claims 0.3-tile range, speed 20, cadence 1.2 seconds, six-tile isolation, x2 damage and x1.5 attack speed. Its stated 40% trap reduction conflicts with Supercell's later note that a further reduction occurred.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued Hero levels had no dated TH18 numeric evidence record.
changed_values.replacement: TH18 L21-L25 receive source-traced health and DPS observations while combat activation remains disabled.
changed_values.justification: Exact source-traced numeric values can be preserved independently from an unresolved base attack contract.

items: current base range conflict: 0.3 versus 1.25 tiles
current base cadence has no primary corroboration
projectile or direct-contact launch and collision timing
current trap reduction after the official July further reduction
isolation transition ordering and precise eligible-flying-unit set
damage and cadence stacking while enraged
source-verified Viewer asset, placement and scale

conclusion: Dragon Duke current TH18 numeric evidence is retained, but Core materialization, base attack and Royal Rampage remain unavailable. This is an explicit partial data increment, not an implementation claim.
